title: Aoyagi Toya — What Happened To What I Felt〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: What Happened To What I Felt（2★）

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Oh, hey there.
Feel free to sit wherever you like.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then, I'll sit at the counter.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's strange seeing no other customers here at this time...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Well, a lot of events are going on at the same time today.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: If anything, this is like the calm before the storm. Once they're all done, everyone's going to want to stay out and stampede over.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm not sure if this counts as a hint or clue, but I did notice something...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I may be mistaken...
But something about all the performers' voices felt sad or dispirited for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What?
Even though everyone was going totally nuts?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That time... What was it that I was feeling...?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (As Shiraishi said, knowing that Ken and his team would be disbanding may've had a lot to do with it...)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Is there something you'd like to ask me...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
It's written all over your face.
Also, here's your coffee.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Lately, it's become a little easier to see how you're feeling based on your facial expressions... But of all my regulars, you're still a puzzle to me.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hahaha! Conversely, Akito and Kohane are the easiest to read.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I understand Azusawa, but I wasn't expecting to hear Akito's name.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Especially since he usually does his absolute best to bury anything he doesn't want people to know about...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And it's very difficult to see that when it actually happens.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: To be fair, I've been alive a bit longer than the rest of you, so I know a thing or two when it comes to that.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Anyway, what is it that you'd like to ask? It must be bothering you very much based on how anxious you seemed just now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, well...
I'm not sure if I should ask...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I'll be taking care of some business, so you just talk like I'm not here. I might be willing to answer depending on what you say.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, I watched the DVD of RAD WEEKEND with everyone the other day...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And for some reason, I felt this strange sense of sadness in all the performers' voices as they sang...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I don't understand why that thought crossed my mind...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sorry if this seems inappropriate...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I'm struggling to wrap my head around what I felt and why I felt what I did that time...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: You really are changing little by little, Toya. Of course, for the better...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Until just recently, you never actively tried to express or discuss what you were feeling, right?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: But you're doing your best to blaze your own trail anyway. I'm not even your parent and I feel pretty proud of you.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Everyone's going to think or feel something different when they see an event. Honestly, it's a folly to try to understand what the performers were feeling.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: And yet, you clearly felt something even though you're still not entirely used to comprehending such emotions...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: So, you should remember what you felt.
